In this Chart Fanatics episode, we are joined by Steven Dux who traded $27,000 to over $50 million. He breaks down the 3 short selling setups behind his biggest trades: gap up short, bounce short and first red day.
He explains the exact market cap rules, float requirements, volume criteria, sector filters, win rates, risk management and psychology behind each setup, including how he made around $1.5 million in just 15 minutes and the framework behind his $7 million trade.
This is one of the most detailed breakdowns we have ever filmed.
